tools.name: sec_get_filing_index

tools.description: Get U.S. economic indicators from BLS — CPI (inflation), PPI (producer prices), Non-farm Payrolls (employment), Unemployment Rate, JOLTS. Filter by category.

tools.name: get_financial_stress
tools.description: Get the OFR Financial Stress Index — a daily indicator of stress in global financial markets. Values above 0 indicate above-average stress.

tools.name: get_crypto_exposure
tools.description: Get a market-wide summary of institutional exposure to US spot crypto ETFs (Bitcoin ETF complex: IBIT, FBTC, GBTC, etc.) from the latest quarter of SEC 13F filings. Returns total institutional USD held, quarter-over-quarter change, and a per-ETF breakdown (holders, USD, QoQ).

tools.name: get_crypto_holders
tools.description: List institutional investors holding US spot crypto ETFs (Bitcoin ETF complex), ranked by total USD held, from the latest quarter of SEC 13F filings. Optionally filter to holders of a specific ETF via the `product` parameter (e.g. 'IBIT').

tools.name: get_crypto_holder
tools.description: Get one institution's spot crypto-ETF holdings (Bitcoin ETF complex): its per-ETF positions in the latest filed quarter (shares, USD, QoQ change, action) plus its rank among all crypto-ETF holders. Use a CIK number (find it with get_crypto_holders or the search tool).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_form144_notices · Private data: list_institutions, get_insider_trades, search, sec_get_filing_index, sec_get_filing_document · Public sink: get_institution_holdings, get_stock_activity, get_insider_trades, get_form144_notices, get_ftd_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_form144_notices · Private data: list_institutions, get_insider_trades, search, sec_get_filing_index, sec_get_filing_document · Public sink: get_institution_holdings, get_stock_activity, get_insider_trades, get_form144_notices, get_ftd_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_institution_holdings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
